# codereel

> A browser editor that turns code into short animated videos for 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 and 4:5.

codereel is a client-side Next.js application. API keys and user content stay in the browser. The specification is the source of truth; `npm run verify` is the deterministic quality gate.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/edgeorgie/codereel/blob/main/README.md): what it does, how to run it, data flow
- [Specification](https://github.com/edgeorgie/codereel/blob/main/docs/spec/spec.md): requirements and acceptance criteria
- [Requirements as JSON](https://github.com/edgeorgie/codereel/blob/main/docs/spec/requirements.json): machine-readable list with status, files and tests
- [Traceability](https://github.com/edgeorgie/codereel/blob/main/docs/spec/traceability.md): requirement to code, test and evidence
- [Architecture](https://github.com/edgeorgie/codereel/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): diagrams and modules
- [Agent workflow](https://github.com/edgeorgie/codereel/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules and quality gates
